A research checklist for each league, with game-by-game history and five- and seven-game trends.

Snapshot updated
Nov 01, 2026 · 02:29 PM EST
All times Toronto

One season. Game-by-game evidence. No assumed psychological bonuses.

Every candidate has a definition and source status. Choose what to track or test, and add your own ideas. A saved plan does not change the live model's weights. Rest days are off by default.

Your homecoming hypothesis

We will flag the first genuine home game after four or more consecutive away games. Neutral-site games interrupt this strictly-away sequence. The flag is known from the preceding game sequence, before the home game's result.

This can test whether the situation is associated with a performance change. It does not tell us whether players saw their partners or families, or whether they felt relieved, motivated or distracted. We can observe the schedule pattern; its effect remains to be tested.
